cards.label: Melo Clutches Up at the Garden

tooltip.description: With 13.5 seconds left, Carmelo Anthony drills a deep three over Taj Gibson to tie the game and ignite Madison Square Garden.

cards.label: Harden Breaks Ankles, Then Drains It

tooltip.description: James Harden drops Wesley Johnson with a crossover, pauses to stare him down, then nails the step-back three.
Reggie Miller shocks the Knicks with 8 points in just 9 seconds — two threes, a steal, and game-sealing free throws.
tooltip.quote: "Reggie Miller scoring 8 points in 9 seconds! Unbelievable!"

tooltip.description: Shawn Kemp throws down a vicious double-clutch dunk over Alton Lister, then points at him as he falls — pure disrespect.
tooltip.quote: "That's one of the greatest in-game dunks EVER."

tooltip.description: Facing elimination, Klay Thompson hits an NBA playoff record 11 threes — including clutch bombs late — to save the Warriors in Game 6.
After Shai ties it with 1.4 seconds left, Devonte’ Graham responds with a 61-foot buzzer-beater — the longest in NBA history.
tooltip.quote: "He threw that from the other free-throw line!"

cards.label: Wade Calls Game in Double OT

tooltip.description: Dwyane Wade picks off a pass in double OT, hits a running three at the buzzer, then leaps on the table yelling, 'This is my house!'
Klay Thompson scores 37 points in the 3rd quarter vs. the Pacers, going 13-for-13 from the field and 9-for-9 from deep — an NBA record.
Shaquille O’Neal dunks with such power that the entire backboard collapses — forcing the NBA to reinforce its rims league-wide.
In Game 7 of the 2016 Finals, LeBron James races down and blocks Andre Iguodala’s layup to preserve a tied score late in the 4th.

cards.label: Kobe to Shaq Seals the Comeback

tooltip.description: In Game 7 of the 2000 West Finals, Kobe lobs it to Shaq for the exclamation point alley-oop to cap a 15-point comeback vs. Portland.
Dirk Nowitzki drives left and hits a clutch game-winning layup over Chris Bosh to steal Game 2 of the 2011 Finals in Miami.
tooltip.quote: "Nowitzki with the left hand! Banks it in!"

cards.label: Wade Destroys Varejão at the Rim

tooltip.description: Dwyane Wade detonates on Anderson Varejão with a soaring one-handed poster dunk — sending him to the floor and the arena into chaos.

cards.label: Kobe Buzzer-Beater to Beat the Suns

tooltip.description: In Game 4 of the 2006 playoffs, Kobe ties the game in OT, then hits the buzzer-beater fadeaway to give the Lakers the win over Phoenix.

cards.label: Pippen Posters Ewing, Then Talks Trash

tooltip.description: Scottie Pippen detonates on Patrick Ewing in Game 6 of the 1994 playoffs, then steps over him and taunts Spike Lee courtside.
LeBron catches the inbounds with one second left and nails a turnaround three at the buzzer to beat the Magic in Game 2 of the ECF.

cards.label: Dr. J Floats Behind the Backboard

tooltip.description: Julius Erving drives baseline and hangs in the air behind the backboard before flipping in a reverse layup in the 1980 Finals.
tooltip.quote: "That’s the greatest move I’ve ever seen!"

cards.label: Fisher Wins It with 0.4 Seconds Left

tooltip.description: Derek Fisher stuns San Antonio with a turnaround jumper off the inbounds — all with just 0.4 seconds left on the clock.
Vince Carter detonates on Alonzo Mourning with a one-handed poster dunk — one of the greatest body-to-body facials in NBA history.
tooltip.quote: "Oh no! He did it on Zo!"

tooltip.description: Aaron Gordon leaps over a spinning mascot on a hoverboard and throws down an under-the-legs dunk — one of the most iconic ever.
tooltip.quote: "That is one of the best dunks I've ever seen!"

cards.label: Iverson Steps Over Lue in Game 1

tooltip.description: Allen Iverson hits a clutch jumper over Tyronn Lue in Game 1 of the 2001 Finals — then steps over him in an iconic taunt.
Gerald Green catches an alley-oop and throws down a windmill dunk in mid-air — one of the greatest in-game lobs ever.
tooltip.quote: "Did you see that? Gerald Green with levitation!"

tooltip.description: Rookie Allen Iverson shakes Michael Jordan with a lightning crossover and buries the jumper — a defining moment of his fearless rise.
Derrick Jones Jr. catches a lob in transition and throws down a lefty windmill — pure flight from Airplane Mode.
Blake Griffin rises over Kendrick Perkins and throws down a brutal two-handed poster — a defining dunk of the Lob City era.

cards.label: Jordan Flies from the Free-Throw Line

tooltip.description: Michael Jordan takes off from the free-throw line in the 1988 Dunk Contest — a legendary leap that defined greatness.
LeBron scores 29 of the Cavs' last 30, including back-to-back go-ahead drives in double OT — a legendary Game 5 takeover.
tooltip.quote: "This is Jordanesque — this is legend in the making!"

tooltip.description: Vince Carter stuns the crowd with a 360 windmill in the 2000 Dunk Contest — then declares, 'It's over!'

cards.label: Kobe Drops 60 in His Final Game

tooltip.description: In the final game of his career, 37-year-old Kobe drops 60 and hits the go-ahead jumper with 30 seconds left.
DeAndre Jordan obliterates Brandon Knight with one of the most brutal alley-oop posters ever.
Steph Curry becomes the NBA's all-time leader in made threes at Madison Square Garden.
tooltip.quote: "STEPHEN CURRY... the all-time three-point king in the NBA!" – Mike Breen

tooltip.description: Jordan's iconic buzzer-beater over Craig Ehlo to win Game 5 in 1989.
tooltip.quote: "Good! Bulls win it! They win it!" – Jim Durham

tooltip.description: Giannis recovers and blocks an alley-oop in Game 4 of the 2021 Finals.
tooltip.quote: "One of the greatest recovery blocks you will ever see!" – Jeff Van Gundy

tooltip.description: Magic floats a baby hook over the Celtics to win Game 4 of the 1987 Finals.
LeBron annihilates Jason Terry with an alley-oop dunk so violent it went viral.
tooltip.quote: "It’s one of the most disrespectful dunks you’ll ever see." – NBA on ESPN

tooltip.description: Larry Bird steals the ball and throws a perfect assist for the game-winning layup in Game 5 against the Hawks.
tooltip.quote: "Oh, and there’s a steal by Bird!" – Celtics Broadcast

tooltip.description: Damian Lillard drains a 37-foot buzzer-beater to eliminate the Thunder in 2019.
Giannis flies past defenders to throw down a massive dunk over Courtney Lee.
tooltip.quote: "That's why he's the MVP!" – Mike Breen

tooltip.description: Kawhi Leonard sinks a game-winning buzzer-beater to send the Raptors to the Eastern Conference Finals.
tooltip.quote: "The shot! The shot! Kawhi Leonard!" – TNT Broadcast

tooltip.description: Kyrie Irving hits a game-winning three-pointer to clinch the Cavaliers' first NBA title.
tooltip.quote: "Irving for three! It's good!" – ESPN Broadcast

tooltip.description: Ray Allen drains the iconic corner three to force Game 6 of the 2013 NBA Finals into overtime, one of the most clutch shots in NBA history.
tooltip.quote: "One of the greatest shots ever made in NBA history."

tooltip.description: LeBron James makes a crucial block on Andre Iguodala during the 2016 NBA Finals, a pivotal moment in the Cavaliers' championship run.
tooltip.quote: "The Block" — one of LeBron’s most iconic defensive plays.

cards.label: Michael Jordan’s Final Shot vs Jazz

tooltip.description: Michael Jordan hits the game-winning jumper in Game 6 of the 1998 NBA Finals, securing his sixth championship.
tooltip.quote: "The shot that sealed the legacy of MJ."

tooltip.description: Tracy McGrady hits a miraculous game-winning shot over the Spurs to secure an unforgettable victory.
